import java.util.*;
import java.math.BigInteger;

public class Main {
    private static final int MOD = 998244353;
    private static final int MOD2 = 1000000007;
    private static long[] pw10 = new long[17];
    private static Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);

    private static long nextLong() {
        return scanner.nextLong();
    }

    private static int nextInt() {
        return scanner.nextInt();
    }

    private static String nextString() {
        return scanner.next();
    }

    private static String toString(BigInteger num) {
        return num.toString();
    }

    private static void solve(List<Integer> variables, int base, BigInteger[] ans) {
        int n = variables.size();
        int half = n / 2;
        List<Integer> rem1 = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> rem2 = new ArrayList<>();

        // first half
        int[] cur = new int[]{base};
        int until = half;
        brute(0, cur, until, variables, rem1);
        rem2 = new ArrayList<>(rem1);
        rem1.clear();
        cur[0] = 0;
        until = n;
        brute(half, cur, until, variables, rem1);

        Collections.sort(rem1);
        Collections.sort(rem2);

        long totalrsum = 0;
        for (int b : rem2) {
            totalrsum += b;
        }

        int j = rem2.size() - 1;
        for (int a : rem1) {
            while (j >= 0 && (long)a + rem2.get(j) >= MOD) {
                --j;
            }
            long add = (long)a * rem2.size() + totalrsum - (long)(rem2.size() - 1 - j) * MOD;
            ans[0] = ans[0].add(BigInteger.valueOf(add));
        }
    }

    private static void brute(int pos, int[] cur, int until, List<Integer> variables, List<Integer> rem) {
        if (pos == until) {
            rem.add(cur[0]);
            return;
        }
        int oldcur = cur[0];
        for (int t = 0; t < 10; ++t) {
            brute(pos + 1, cur, until, variables, rem);
            cur[0] += variables.get(pos);
            if (cur[0] >= MOD) {
                cur[0] -= MOD;
            }
        }
        cur[0] = oldcur;
    }

    private static long countWithPrefix(String s, long n, String nStr) {
        long ans = 0;
        long sVal = 0;
        for (char ch : s.toCharArray()) {
            sVal = 10 * sVal + (ch - '0');
        }
        for (int len = s.length(); len <= nStr.length(); ++len) {
            if (len < nStr.length()) {
                ans += pw10[len - s.length()];
            } else {
                int cmp = s.compareTo(nStr.substring(0, s.length()));
                if (cmp < 0) {
                    ans += pw10[len - s.length()];
                } else if (cmp == 0) {
                    ans += (n + 1) - sVal * pw10[nStr.length() - s.length()];
                }
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        pw10[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < 17; ++i) {
            pw10[i] = 10 * pw10[i - 1];
        }

        long n = nextLong();
        String nStr = Long.toString(n);

        BigInteger ans = BigInteger.ZERO;

        for (int len = 1; len <= nStr.length(); ++len) {
            long cur = 0;
            StringBuilder curst = new StringBuilder();

            for (int firstdiff = 0; firstdiff < nStr.length() && firstdiff < len; ++firstdiff) {
                if (firstdiff > 0) {
                    cur = 10 * cur + (nStr.charAt(firstdiff - 1) - '0');
                    curst.append(nStr.charAt(firstdiff - 1));
                }

                for (int lastdig = 0; lastdig <= 9; ++lastdig) {
                    if (firstdiff == 0 && lastdig == 0) continue;
                    if (lastdig == nStr.charAt(firstdiff) - '0') continue;
                    if (len == nStr.length() && lastdig > nStr.charAt(firstdiff) - '0') continue;

                    long curp = 10 * cur + lastdig;
                    String curstp = curst.toString() + (char)('0' + lastdig);

                    long base = 0;
                    StringBuilder tmp = new StringBuilder();
                    for (int pos = 0; pos < curstp.length(); ++pos) {
                        char start = (pos == 0) ? '1' : '0';
                        for (char dig = start; dig < curstp.charAt(pos); ++dig) {
                            base += countWithPrefix(tmp.toString() + dig, n, nStr);
                        }
                        tmp.append(curstp.charAt(pos));
                    }
                    base += len - 1;

                    List<Integer> variables = new ArrayList<>();
                    for (int pos = curstp.length(); pos < len; ++pos) {
                        variables.add((int)(countWithPrefix(tmp.toString() + '0', n, nStr) % MOD));
                        tmp.append('0');
                    }

                    base += 1;
                    base -= curp * pw10[len - curstp.length()];
                    for (int t = 0; t < variables.size(); ++t) {
                        int idx = variables.size() - 1 - t;
                        variables.set(idx, (int)((variables.get(idx) - pw10[t] % MOD) % MOD));
                    }

                    base %= MOD;
                    if (base < 0) base += MOD;

                    for (int i = 0; i < variables.size(); ++i) {
                        int val = variables.get(i) % MOD;
                        if (val < 0) val += MOD;
                        variables.set(i, val);
                    }

                    BigInteger[] ansRef = new BigInteger[]{ans};
                    solve(variables, (int)base, ansRef);
                    ans = ansRef[0];
                }
            }
        }

        // special case: numbers that are a prefix of N
        long cur = 0;
        StringBuilder curst = new StringBuilder();
        for (int len = 1; len <= nStr.length(); ++len) {
            curst.append(nStr.charAt(len - 1));
            cur = 10 * cur + (nStr.charAt(len - 1) - '0');

            long val = 1;
            StringBuilder tmp = new StringBuilder();
            for (int pos = 0; pos < curst.length(); ++pos) {
                char start = (pos == 0) ? '1' : '0';
                for (char dig = start; dig < curst.charAt(pos); ++dig) {
                    val += countWithPrefix(tmp.toString() + dig, n, nStr);
                }
                tmp.append(curst.charAt(pos));
            }
            val += len - 1;
            val -= cur;
            val %= MOD;
            if (val < 0) val += MOD;

            ans = ans.add(BigInteger.valueOf(val));
        }

        ans = ans.mod(BigInteger.valueOf(MOD2));
        System.out.println(toString(ans));
    }
}
